sources.author: Madusha
patch_list: Disables We Love Deals' PairIP / Play licence verification (including its custom-trial re-check) so the app runs after Morphe re-signs it. Launch gate only — the Flutter deals logic and any server-side checks are untouched.
We Love Deals ships no ad SDK, no ad placement and no advertising permission. This only disables any ad-SDK auto-init provider for future builds and removes the vestigial Play-licence permission.

Forces User.has_active_subscription to true in the Dart AOT snapshot (both JSON parse sites), the flag every premium gate branches on, and NOPs the redeem paywall's own branch (tbnz on the gate bool at 0x58eea0) so the redeem flow always r…
